query:
SELECT 
            id as "id!", 
            folder_id as "folder_id!", 
            content as "content!", 
            DATETIME(created_at, 'localtime') as "created_at!: String", 
            DATETIME(updated_at, 'localtime') as "updated_at!: String"
        FROM notes 
        WHERE folder_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 
        ORDER BY created_at ASC
